mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts signal broad economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weak residential construction, reducing economic growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during supply shocks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal aggressive tightening combined with labor market weakness, reducing growth prospects and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
